threat_event: Attacker uses RMM-managed settlement-support servers to pivot into the CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM agents on connected-to servers; RMM technicians outside PCI DSS training and scope
existing_controls: Segmentation between connected-to and CDE; EDR
treatment_plan: Remove RMM agents and move the servers to group-managed tooling (POAM-014)

threat_event: PCI DSS or FTC Safeguards finding because affiliate service providers are not governed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intercompany agreement with 314.4(f) terms; responsibility matrix covers group services only
treatment_plan: Intercompany agreements and a full matrix (POAM-018)

threat_event: The PCI DSS scope description omits connected-to servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scope confirmation did not include RMM-managed servers
treatment_plan: Update the scope description; inform the QSA (POAM-019)

threat_event: Skimming code injected into a hosted checkout page
existing_controls: Script inventory and tamper detection on all pages (2026)

threat_event: Account data compromise in the CDE
treatment_plan: Continue program; annual red team of the CDE

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over consumer bill-pay accounts
existing_controls: Bot detection; step-up MFA for new payees

threat_event: The FTC notice for a notification event involving 500 or more consumers is late
treatment_plan: Add the row to the P08 matrix (POAM-004)

threat_event: A sponsor bank is not notified within 24 hours of a determination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sponsor bank terms not in the group matrix
regulatory_driver: Sponsor bank agreements; card network rules
treatment_plan: Add sponsor bank and card network rows to the matrix (POAM-004)

threat_event: The fraud model declines legitimate transactions disproportionately for some cardholder groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subgroup testing by proxy variables
regulatory_driver: FTC Act Sec. 5; card network rules

threat_event: The merchant underwriting model produces unfair or unexplained declines for small merchants and sole proprietors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No adverse-decision explanation process; Colorado SB26-189 under counsel review
treatment_plan: Decline reason codes and bias testing (P10)

threat_event: A payment HSM key ceremony failure exposes key components
Sponsor bank A ends the card program, halting settlement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One sponsor bank for card acquiring
treatment_plan: Accepted by the division president: a second sponsor bank is a multi-year commercial decision, reviewed each year

threat_event: R1 and R3 fail together and card authorization stops
regulatory_driver: Card network and sponsor bank terms
treatment_plan: Join the shared failure mode exercise (POAM-012)

threat_event: Ransomware on settlement-support servers delays merchant funding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Windows servers in the connected-to segment
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test of settlement-support servers

threat_event: State money transmitter regulators' incident notice duties are not mapped
treatment_plan: Map notice duties per license into the matrix

regulatory_driver: SOC 1 control objectives; sponsor bank terms

threat_event: A covered person accesses bulk personal financial data through a vendor
existing_controls: Sanctions screening; data masking in tickets

threat_event: Merchant portal account takeover changes a deposit account and diverts funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-based merchant users; bank changes allowed online
existing_controls: Bank change hold of 3 days; MFA available
